name: cleancopy
description: Cleans up text copied from the terminal so it pastes neatly into other apps.

scripts.build:helper: swift build -c release --package-path helper && mkdir -p helper/bin && cp helper/.build/release/cleancopy-helper helper/bin/ && codesign --force --sign - helper/bin/cleancopy-helper
scripts.build:helper:universal: swift build -c release --arch arm64 --arch x86_64 --package-path helper && mkdir -p helper/bin && cp helper/.build/apple/Products/Release/cleancopy-helper helper/bin/ && codesign --force --sign - helper/bin/cleancopy-helper
scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "if (!process.env.GITHUB_ACTIONS && !process.env.CLEANCOPY_RELEASE_CHECK) { console.error('publishing runs only from CI (see RELEASING.md); the local dry-run is: npm run release:check'); process.exit(1) }" && npm run build && npm run build:helper:universal && npm run verify:helper:universal && npm test
scripts.release:check: CLEANCOPY_RELEASE_CHECK=1 npm run prepublishOnly && npm pack --dry-run
